1.web: When Saul was returned from following the Philistines, it was told him, saying, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”
1.asv: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.

2.web: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.
2.asv: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

3.web: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were abiding in the innermost parts of the cave.
3.asv: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet. Now David and his men were abiding in the innermost parts of the cave.

4.web: The men of David said to him, “Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.
4.asv: And the men of David said unto him, Behold, the day of which Jehovah said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thy hand, and thou shalt do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.

5.web: Afterward, David’s heart struck him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
5.asv: And it came to pass afterward, that David’s heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

6.web: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is Yahweh’s anointed.”
6.asv: And he said unto his men, Jehovah forbid that I should do this thing unto my lord, Jehovah’s anointed, to put forth my hand against him, seeing he is Jehovah’s anointed.

7.web: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
7.asv: So David checked his men with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. And Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

8.web: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.
8.asv: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and did obeisance.

9.web: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks your hurt?’
9.asv: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearkenest thou to men’s words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?

10.web: Behold, this day your eyes have seen how that Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you; but I spared you; and I said, I will not stretch out my hand against my lord; for he is Yahweh’s anointed.
10.asv: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that Jehovah had delivered thee to-day into my hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee; but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth my hand against my lord; for he is Jehovah’s anointed.

11.web: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe, and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand, and I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.
11.asv: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in my hand, and I have not sinned against thee, though thou huntest after my life to take it.

12.web: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand shall not be on you.
12.asv: Jehovah judge between me and thee, and Jehovah avenge me of thee; but my hand shall not be upon thee.

13.web: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand shall not be on you.
13.asv: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Out of the wicked cometh forth wickedness; but my hand shall not be upon thee.

14.web: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?
14.asv: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.

15.web: May Yahweh therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”
15.asv: Jehovah therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thy hand.

16.web: It came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is this your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
16.asv: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

17.web: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
17.asv: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I; for thou hast rendered unto me good, whereas I have rendered unto thee evil.

18.web: You have declared this day how you have dealt well with me, because when Yahweh had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.
18.asv: And thou hast declared this day how that thou hast dealt well with me, forasmuch as when Jehovah had delivered me up into thy hand, thou killedst me not.

19.web: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you have done to me this day.
19.asv: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore Jehovah reward thee good for that which thou hast done unto me this day.

20.web: Now, behold, I know that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in your hand.
20.asv: And now, behold, I know that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thy hand.

21.web: Swear now therefore to me by Yahweh, that you will not cut off my seed after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”
21.asv: Swear now therefore unto me by Jehovah, that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father’s house.

22.web: David swore to Saul. Saul went home; but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
22.asv: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the stronghold.
